svg.title: How LLM Security Gateway works
svg.desc: Requests from your app pass through the gateway before reaching the LLM API: 01 rate limit (429 on abuse), 02 prompt-injection check (403 BLOCKED), 03 PII masking (e-mail becomes [EMAIL]). Responses are scanned for leaked PII on the way back.
svg.text: response is scanned for leaked PII on the way back
